General Intent: Edit the image to convey the excitement of a new beginning or grand opening.
Detailed Editing Steps: Remove all the trash from in and around the dumpster. Add a large, red ceremonial ribbon tied into a bow around the middle of the dumpster. Add a pair of oversized, shiny golden scissors held by an unseen person, positioned as if about to cut the ribbon. Change the text on the dumpster to something celebratory like 'GRAND OPENING'. The scene should be clean and bright, suggesting a momentous and exciting occasion.
